failOpenDefects.mechanism: When OCCT booleanIntersect() and common() throw exceptions, intersectSolid is set to null and execution continues without registering an error. If all pairs throw, the engine returns status: 'NO_INTERFERENCE'.
When assembly instances do not match hardcoded test case positions, the method unconditionally returns { status: 'CLEAR', clashes: [] } without evaluating any geometry.
If either instance is missing in assembly structure, returns { hasCollision: false, minimumClearance: 100 } rather than failing closed with an error or invalid state.
Dynamic interference check returns hasTransientCollision: false unconditionally without running kinematics or geometric intersection.

canonicalAuthorityStatus.details: CollisionAuthority enforces fail-closed semantics (returns ANALYSIS_FAILED with provenSafe=false on throw, missing provider, or invalid input).
